contracts: pNotifyBuffer is checked before SERVICE_NOTIFY dereference
dwVersion is accepted only for locally supported versions 1 or 2
pfnNotifyCallback is non-null before registration succeeds
dwNotifyMask is nonzero before registration succeeds

SCM_NOTIFY_GLOBAL and SCM_NOTIFY_ELEM allocation failures return ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY
CreateEvent failure returns the Win32 failure code
CreateThread failure returns the Win32 failure code
Existing notification entries update data and mask on re-registration
APC callback dispatch checks pfnNotifyCallback before calling it
Scm_WaitServiceState copies current_state before freeing SERVICE_QUERY_RPL
